organization.name: AAMVA
organization.legalName: American Association of Motor Vehicle Administrators
organization.description: Non-profit association of motor vehicle and law enforcement agencies in the United States and Canada. AAMVA governs the mobile driver's licence (mDL) implementation guidelines built on ISO/IEC 18013-5 and operates the Digital Trust Service (DTS), the VICAL used by verifiers to establish trust in issuing authority certificates.
